The '''Agashkinic Languages''' are a branch of the [[Zhensanovian Languages]] associated in source material with the southern steppes of the [[Union of Zhensanov]].

The source describes Agashkinic languages as having vowel harmony, a large vowel inventory, postpositional grammar, ejective consonants, and a traditional syllabic script.

== Canon Limits ==

The extracted source does not provide pre-1994 political status, standardized curricula, or precise borders for Agashkinic-speaking regions. Those details remain open.
